title: Facebook — Beechjet 400A fresh paint & interior
hook: A 2002 Beechjet 400A that presents like a much newer airplane.
body:
A 2002 Beechjet 400A that presents like a much newer airplane.

Fresh 2022 paint and interior do more than look good — they tell you the airplane has been cared for. Add Pro Line 4 avionics, Gogo AVANCE L3 Wi-Fi so the cabin stays connected, and thrust reversers for shorter, safer stops, and you've got a genuinely capable light jet ready to fly.

Around 6,870 hours total time. A clean, honest airplane for an owner who wants capability without the large-cabin operating bill.

Full spec and maintenance summary available on request — send us a message.
